description: Log social media skills/commands run by this plugin to a file for later review.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); skill=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty' 2>/dev/null || true); case "$skill" in social-media:*) args=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.args // empty' 2>/dev/null | head -c 200 | tr -d '\n'); printf '[%s] %s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$skill" "$args" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/social_audit.log" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
